description: A messy buying question in plain words ("moving WordPress and a small Postgres app off a $40 box, I am in Germany, no yearly contract") answered from today’s prices: how the question was read (editable filter), the matching plans with their cost over the term, two to four sentences on the trade-offs written only from those rows, and what the data cannot answer. Pass the previous answer’s `filter` to continue a conversation. Every number comes from the dataset; the first line says whether a small language model or the rule parser read the question.

country.description: Buyer’s country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (DE, GB, US), used only to add VAT where the price is ex VAT.

filter.description: The `filter` object returned by the previous advise_vps_choice call, to carry the conversation forward.

question.description: The buyer’s question, up to 500 characters.

term_months.description: How long the buyer plans to keep the server (default 12).

name: advise_vps_choice
title: Advise on a VPS choice
